verdict.rationale: Superhuman has a search feature with a stated offline-availability design goal, plus Ask AI natural-language answers drawn from the inbox. Hands-on reports on speed conflict: one user calls search blazing fast, while others report ten-second archive searches and long-standing search issues. missing for 10: documented search operators, filters, ranked results, explicit full-history coverage, and consistent independent confirmation of search speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.
You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
search and UI transitions are blazing fast
